select au.* from tb_anchor_url au
and au.platform = #{bo.platform}
and au.anchor_name like CONCAT('%', #{bo.anchorName}, '%')
and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_url_white auw where auw.sec_uid = au.sec_uid)
and not EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_url_white auw where auw.sec_uid = au.sec_uid)
order by au.id desc
